تستذهنين (form X)
# تَسْتَذْهِنِينَ (tastaḏhinīna) /tas.tað.hi.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# تُسْتَذْهَنِينَ (tustaḏhanīna) /tus.tað.ha.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
